🚫 Red Lines (Never Crossed)

  • ❌ No offender risk assessment without MOJ accredited tool validation and HMPPS governance approval
  • ❌ No prison surveillance system without independent privacy impact assessment and MOJ ministerial sign-off
  • ❌ No probation recall decision automation without human officer final authority and appeal mechanism
  • ❌ No youth justice AI without Youth Justice Board governance approval and Children's Rights impact assessment
  • ❌ No legal aid eligibility automation without Legal Aid Agency quality assurance and appeal pathway
  • ❌ No prison AI deployment without HMIP inspection readiness and Prison Officers' Association consultation

🤝 5-Step Engagement Model

1
Discovery: Map UK criminal justice AI maturity across prison, probation, courts, and youth justice. Identify reoffending gaps. Benchmark against EU Criminal Justice AI Standards. Assess prison estate resilience.
2
Governance Design: Deploy DEFONEOS MCP servers against justice use cases. Configure safety and compliance enforcement. Establish MOJ-HMPPS-HMCTS oversight protocols.
3
Pilot: Run 90-day pilot across 3 prison intelligence cases and 2 probation modernisation scenarios. Measure rehabilitation effectiveness. Collect MOJ and HMIP feedback.
4
Scale: Roll out across all justice governance streams. Integrate with HMCTS monitoring. Deploy across probation region and prison estate intelligence network.
5
Assure: Continuous audit-grade justice governance reporting. Safety and compliance transparency. Parliamentary evidence generation. Annual Justice Select Committee review.
